name: Merge Chiikawa
desc:
💥 Merge Chiikawa together to create rarer ones! 💥

Welcome to Merge Chiikawa! Get ready to:

🧸 Combine cute Chiikawas into bigger and better ones! 
💎 Collect gems to power up faster!
🎨 Unlock trails and themes to stand out!
🐾 Get pets that earn you cash while you play!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and compete to be in the top!

🎁: Thumb up the game and join the group for a FREE REWARD!
Start merging and see how many Chiikawas you can find!
